title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Site Reliability Engineer

As a part of Sony Computer Entertainment, the Gaming, Developer & Future Technology Group (GDFT) is leading the cloud gaming revolution, putting console-quality video games on any device, from TVs to consoles to mobile devices and beyond.

Our Site Reliability Engineering team plays a significant role in delivering on the promise of a great cloud gaming experience to our customers. We do this by influencing design and operational decisions towards the overall stability of the gaming service. Our SREs focus on three main things: overall ownership of production, production code quality, and deployments. The successful candidate will be self-directed and able to participate in the way we make decisions at different levels.

title: Werkstudent Rezeptmanagement (all genders)
description:
Deine Rolle

Als Werkstudent/in im Rezeptmanagement unterstützt du unser Rezeptentwicklungsteam bei der Pflege und Verwaltung kulinarischer Daten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Culinary-Operations-Team zusammen und sorgst mit einem guten Blick fürs Detail, Struktur und Sorgfalt dafür, dass Rezepturen korrekt abgebildet und unsere Datensätze zuverlässig gepflegt sind.

Bitte beachte, dass diese Stelle zunächst auf 12 Monate befristet ist.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Rezept-Management: Pflege und Aktualisierung von Rezeptdaten in unseren internen Systemen sowie kurzfristige Anpassung von Rezepten bei Änderungen von Zutaten
  • Korrekturlesen: Prüfung von Rezepten auf korrekte Datenpunkte, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz
  • Rezept-Optimierung: Erstellung und Überprüfung anpassbarer Rezeptvarianten auf Basis bestehender Rezepte
  • Datenkontrolle: Regelmäßige Validierung der Einträge in unserem System sowie systematische Fehleranalyse und -behebung
  • Performance-Analyse: Unterstützung bei der Auswertung von Rezepten auf Basis von Kundenfeedback sowie Zusammenfassung neuer Erkenntnisse und wiederkehrender Muster

Dein Profil 

  • Studium mit Bezug zu Ernährung, Daten, Naturwissenschaften oder Wirtschaft
  • Begeisterung für die Themen Essen und Kochen sowie grundlegendes kulinarisches Verständnis (z. B. Garzeiten, Geschmacksprofile, Zutatenkunde), welches eine fachliche Beurteilung bzw. Bearbeitung von Rezepten ermöglicht - auch ohne selbst am Herd zu stehen
  • Detailverliebtheit, Zuverlässigkeit und ein selbstständiger Arbeitsstil, kombiniert mit Freude an klaren Strukturen und sorgfältiger Datenpflege
  • Lösungsorientiertes Denken und die Fähigkeit, logisch nachvollziehbare Alternativen selbstständig zu entwickeln

title: Supply Chain Planning Working Student (all genders)
description:
Your role

We are looking for a Supply Chain planning working student for 12 months at the heart of our Product team, where you will be responsible for supporting our operational and strategic needs for our physical product: meal kits. You will be central to our activity and will have a significant influence on our customers' meals.

We are looking for someone capable of assisting us in the operational planning of recipes at HelloFresh. This is a unique opportunity to learn and gain experience within a fast-growing company that is pioneering the food industry.

If you want to be a driving force in the growth of a scale-up, then this position is for you!

 

Your area of responsibility

  • Menu creation and optimization: Assist the team in creating and optimizing menus using our python-based menu-planning algorithm.
  • Product Improvement: You will work on several projects and initiatives that focus on improving our product offering aiming to increase customer satisfaction.
  • Menu De-Risking: You will lead a number of cross-collaborative initiatives and processes aiming to reduce the menu risk and to ensure ingredient availability by considering the end-to-end value chain of our product. 
  • Operations support: You support the team in day-to-day operations as well as with administrative and organizational tasks along the supply and menu planning process and have the opportunity to solve concrete problems, make decisions, and learn to manage real-world situations in a dynamic environment.
  • Process management: You will participate in projects aimed at optimizing and automating and improving our product processes and supply chain by working with other teams.

title: Senior Product Delivery Manager, Production (f/m/x)
description:
The role

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Senior Product Delivery Manager at HelloFresh. This role is pivotal to the future of our fulfillment network. You will be at the helm of further developing and deploying a high-profile, highly complex strategic project that fundamentally redefines our production methods and capabilities across our DCs.
Working closely with Tech and Operations Leadership, you will be responsible for taking our new, next-generation production setup and refining its processes, equipment, and layouts. Once optimized, you will lead the charge in deploying this new operational blueprint into other DCs across our international markets.
This is not a traditional desk-bound product role; it requires a strong operational background, deep understanding of physical process design, and the ability to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and on-the-ground execution. The international role will be based in our Berlin office and will involve frequent travel to our local warehouses across markets and potentially extended stays during roll-out periods.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Process and Equipment Design: You will actively design, evaluate, and refine DC layouts, operational workflows, and physical equipment setups for our next-generation production models.
